title: A friend is visiting your city
context_es: Tu amiga inglesa Sophie va a pasar un fin de semana en tu ciudad el mes que viene y te ha escrito para pedirte consejo.
prompt_en: Your English friend Sophie is going to spend a weekend in your city next month. She has asked for your advice. Write an email to Sophie.
points: say you are happy about her visit
recommend two things to see or do
useful_language: It was great to hear from you.
I can’t wait to see you.
tips_es: Es un correo a una amiga: contracciones, tono cercano y un párrafo por idea.
Para aconsejar: *You should…*, *If I were you, I’d…*, *It’s worth* + -ing.
Cubre los cuatro puntos: en un examen, cada punto que falta resta nota.
model_answer:
Hi Sophie,

It was great to hear from you. I'm so glad you're coming to Valencia next month!

You should definitely visit the old town on Saturday morning. The central market is beautiful, and you can try fresh orange juice there. In the afternoon, it's worth walking through the Turia gardens to the science museum, although you need at least two hours to see it properly.

If I were you, I'd stay in a small hotel near the cathedral, because you can walk everywhere and it isn't too expensive. However, book it soon, since it's a busy time of year.

Don't forget to bring comfortable shoes and a light jacket. It's usually warm, but it can be windy in the evenings.

I can't wait to see you!

Love,
Carla
